title: Thread callee graph into diff_impact
description:
## Motivation

`sutra_diff_impact` currently walks the caller graph (inbound blast radius) — "what depends on this changed symbol." It doesn't walk callees — "what does this changed symbol depend on." Sutra already has callee data via `sutra_calls`, but it's not wired into the diff impact path.

## Why it matters

When a function's implementation changes, knowing what it *calls* helps assess whether the change could break downstream behavior. Example: if `process_order()` changed and now calls `charge_card()` instead of `authorize_payment()`, the callee delta is the most important signal — more than knowing who calls `process_order()`.

## Approach sketch

`sutra_calls` already computes callees from resolved refs within a symbol's line range. Extend `sutra_diff_impact` output to include a `callees_changed` section per affected symbol, showing callees added/removed between the two states. This pairs naturally with the function-level structural diff task — if we know a symbol's body changed, we can diff its callee set.

## Prior art

git-prism's `get_function_context` includes both callers and callees per changed function.
